title: Forensic stack event-prediction re-targeting (discrete adverse events)
hypothesis: The preserved forensic feature stack (Benford FSD deviation, m1 sentence-length obfuscation, filing-submission delay) predicts, with significant lift over base rate, the occurrence of a discrete adverse corporate event within the next 12 months. The construct-valid target of forensic signals is discrete events (designation/halt/delisting), NOT the monthly portfolio tail (rejected R20).

verdict_frame_2stage.stage1_this_round: Judge PREDICTION VALIDITY ONLY. A significant prediction does NOT license any capital/portfolio improvement claim.
verdict_frame_2stage.stage2_separate_round: IF prediction holds (controlled residual lift significant AND stable), THEN a filter-redesign round (exclude event-risk top tail; R18 consumption frame) is opened separately. IF not, forensic stack = feature-preserve TERMINATE.

event_target.definition: For decision-month t (feature known), E_{i,t}=1 iff stock i experiences ANY adverse-event onset in the forward window months [t+1, t+12].

components.UnfaithfulDisc_onset: monthly transition 0->1 of UnfaithfulDisc flag (new 불성실공시 designation). available 2009+.
components.AdminStock_onset: monthly transition 0->1 of AdminStock flag (new 관리종목 designation). available 1990+.
components.LongTradingHalt_onset: daily TradingHalt>0 run >= 20 consecutive trading days (long halt, distinguishing structural halts from transient/administrative). onset month = first month of qualifying run. available 1993+.
components.Delisting: month of a ticker's last observation, when last_obs_date < data_end - 180 days AND ticker has no subsequent re-listing (last observation = market disappearance, C6). This is the delisting event month.

event_target.dedup_rule: Onsets require prior-month flag==0 (or absent) so state persistence is not re-counted. Target is binary ANY-event-in-window; multiple component onsets in one window count once.
event_target.censoring: Drop decision-months t where t+12 exceeds data_end (2026-07); with feature panels ending <=2025-06, forward window fully observable for all retained months.
event_target.survivorship_note: rawdata universe (K200/KQ150 support) may under-retain fully delisted micro-caps; direction of bias = fewer delisting events observed = HARDER to detect prediction = CONSERVATIVE for a positive verdict.

predictors.note: worst decile = per-month cross-sectional TOP decile of a mechanism-driven suspect value (higher = more forensically suspect). Direction is pre-specified by mechanism, NOT fit to events.

F3_delay.suspect: -score (raw=days late vs 90d deadline, sign=-1 => low score = later filing)

STACK.definition: 1 iff >=2 of {F1 D10, F2 D10, F3 D10} in month t, over common months where all three features exist (~2011-04..2025-03)

tests_per_predictor.a_lift: P(E | pred=1) / base_rate, with Wilson 95% CI and ticker-cluster bootstrap CI (1000 reps).
tests_per_predictor.b_auc: ROC AUC of continuous suspect value vs E, with 95% CI (bootstrap by ticker).
tests_per_predictor.c_controlled_residual: AUTHORITATIVE. logistic E ~ pred + log(Size) + liq_z + K200 + KQ150, ticker-cluster-robust SE. Report OR and p on the feature term. If OR->1 & insignificant after controls => 'size-disguise' verdict.
tests_per_predictor.d_stability: re-estimate lift and controlled OR on pre-2016 vs post-2016 (>=2016) subsamples.

universe: Full feature-ticker universe (all stock-months where the feature exists). This is an event-prediction study, not a portfolio; deployment universe constraint does not bind. Tier breakdown (K200/KQ150/OTHER) reported.
pit: Feature at decision-month t; events strictly in [t+1, t+12]. Flag onset month = public designation date (forward-looking). C4/C5 compliant. Event-label PIT caveat (designation date vs cause date) surfaced in challenge_note.
selection_type: sweep (4 enumerated predictors) -> Bonferroni-adjusted p across 4 + DSR-context note (metric is AUC/OR, not Sharpe; DSR reported for governance parity).

prereg_verdict_rule.PREDICTION_HOLDS: IF >=1 predictor (single or stack) has controlled OR>1 with cluster-robust p<0.05 AND directionally stable (pre-2016 AND post-2016 controlled OR both >1).
prereg_verdict_rule.PREDICTION_FAILS: ELSE. forensic stack = feature-preserve TERMINATE; no filter-redesign round opened.
prereg_verdict_rule.language_discipline: negative verdict phrased as 'config-scoped negative + frontier tag', next_probe >= 2 mandatory.
